warnings: Warnings • FLAMMABLE. DO NOT USE NEAR HEAT, FLAME, OR WHILE SMOKING. CAN CAUSE SERIOUS INJURY OR DEATH • Keep away from face and mouth to avoid breathing in. • Avoid spraying in eyes. Stop use if rash or irritation occurs. • Ask a doctor before using if you have kidney disease. • USE ONLY AS DIRECTED.
